title: Nourishing Brazilian Buttermilk Pudding
description: A creamy and tangy dessert recipe inspired by Brazilian cuisine, made with buttermilk and a hint of tropical flavor.
instructions: In a small saucepan, warm the coconut oil over low heat.
In a separate mixing bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and coconut sugar until pale and thickened.
Gradually pour the warm coconut oil into the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to prevent scrambling.
Add the unsweetened shredded coconut, salt, and lime zest to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Pour in the buttermilk and whisk until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps.
Pour the mixture into a copper pot or a medium saucepan set over medium heat.
Cook the pudding over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 10 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the heat and stir in the freshly squeezed lime juice.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with toasted coconut flakes if desired.
